answers.answer: Confirmed, correction accepted. This run's market_inputs.macro.smh_change_pct (+4.02%) carries bar_dates.smh=2026-09-21 -- it is Monday's close-to-close settle, not a fresh overnight/premarket move. smh_live shows Tuesday premarket roughly flat: 591.90 vs prev_close 596.03 = -0.69% (as_of 2026-09-22T09:28:05Z, session=pre). I was not dispatched for a session/regime read this run (answer-only round, scout is not on this run's roster), so no output of mine this run cited the +4.02% figure as fresh information -- there is nothing of my own to revise here. For the record: my most recent standing regime finding (macro:regime, as_of 2026-09-21, expires 2026-09-22 -- today) used a different intraday SMH snapshot (+2.04% cash, taken mid-session Monday), not this stale post-close bar, and it is set to expire today regardless of this correction. Flagging forward: the next full scout run should read smh_live.changePct (session-aware) rather than macro.smh_change_pct when characterizing 'today's move' for the regime_note/session_read, since the latter is always the prior settle until a fresh bar prints intraday.

evidence.claim: smh_live premarket -0.69% (591.90 vs prev_close 596.03), session=pre, as_of 2026-09-22T09:28:05Z
prior standing finding macro:regime used SMH +2.04% (cash, mid-session 09-21), not +4.02%, and expires 2026-09-22

learned.text: market_inputs.macro.*_change_pct fields are close-to-close vs the prior settle (check bar_dates before quoting one as 'today's move') -- on a pre-market run they describe the PRIOR session, not overnight/premarket action. Use the paired *_live sub-object (e.g. smh_live.changePct, session-aware) when characterizing the current session before the cash open. Caught 2026-09-22 when catalyst flagged that this run's AMBIGUOUS gate classification cited SMH +4.02% (Monday 09-21's close-to-close bar) while premarket was flat at -0.69%.
